posts.title: momentarily useful
posts.description: I've come up with a simple way to encapsulate the benefits of LLMs we refer to as AI: momentarily useful. To explain, let me first present my good use cases for LLMs. Then, I'll contrast that with what they are disastrously bad at doing, and why "momentarily useful" explains the gap.

posts.title: being unbuyable
posts.description: There are only two types of folks in business: Buyable or not. Founders often try to find the latter by emphasizing "mission-driven" cultures. Over the last decade, I've slowly realized my intuition has carved out a middle path between money and mission that defines how I hire.

posts.title: vibe management
posts.description: I remember the moment I realized we were doomed. An executive demanding change based on their feelings never goes well for anyone.
